label: Required-edge acyclicity characterizes strict extension (inference)
rule: Compose each finite path inside any proposed strict order; in the reverse direction take the transitive closure of the required edges
meaning: For arbitrary fixed exercise data, every strict extension contains the nonempty finite paths. Irreflexivity excludes their diagonal. If the required edges are acyclic, their transitive closure is itself an irreflexive transitive extension. No semantic identification of other priority relations follows.
